title: A clearer way to choose your UA gear
lede: Put the catalog first, make each choice readable, and let staff finish their picks in one review panel.

sections.heading: Before and after
sections.note: The baseline is the hardened picker from the first pass, including its uncommitted changes. Matching staff fixtures, viewports, light theme, clock, and scroll; synthetic page shell, not authenticated application proof.

pairs.title: Desktop catalog
pairs.beforeCap: Nine standard-issue thumbnails and five narrow product columns competed for attention.
pairs.afterCap: A compact kit disclosure and four wider columns give names, prices, and color choices clear space.

pairs.title: Narrow-screen catalog
pairs.beforeCap: Long product names crowded and clipped prices; category chips scrolled out of view.
pairs.afterCap: Prices sit below names. A Filters button exposes category and collection controls, while budget feedback stays visible.

pairs.title: Review without backtracking
pairs.beforeCap: Size changes required closing review and finding the product again.
pairs.afterCap: Size and quantity are editable here, with immediate totals and the same save protections.

changes.was: A row of nine thumbnails took priority over shopping.
changes.now: The kit remains one click away, with a clear explanation that it does not use the allowance.

changes.h: Names, prices and selection each have a place
changes.was: Small cards placed names beside prices and tiny swatches over photos. A border was the main selection signal.
changes.now: Wider cards stack name and price, use 44-pixel swatch targets, and label selected products with a check and picked quantity.

changes.h: Review becomes a place to finish
changes.was: Staff could inspect or remove picks, but had to return to cards for size changes.
changes.now: Size and quantity controls update the draft and budget immediately. Controls lock during saves, and invalid sizes still block submission.

verification: 9 isolated Chromium browser checks pass, including save/reload regressions, keyboard kit expansion, mobile filters, and inline review edits.
The new inline-review regression fails on the preserved pre-design source because the controls do not exist.

Application build, changed-file lint, docs verification, local links and diff checks passed. Standalone TypeScript reports the same two existing iOS test errors; authenticated preview remains pending.
notes: No commit, push or deployment. Changes remain on codex/ua-picker-hardening.
The profile pick list still receives no edit callbacks and remains read-only. The shared color swatches are larger in the product preview too.
Synthetic API responses prove client interactions only. They do not prove authenticated sessions or persisted database writes.
The existing standalone TypeScript errors are in two unrelated iOS test files; no managed preview exists for this branch.
Wording corrected to Standard issue, covered by the department separately from the pick allowance. Historical before captures retain their original wording.
